signal: Alvys closed a $40M Series B led by RTP Global to scale AI-driven freight ops for carriers and brokers

email.body1:
Patrick, saw Alvys closed its $40M Series B to scale AI-driven freight operations.

Growth capital like that usually means more in-market carriers and brokers than the team can cover before they cool, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alvys off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Patrick, quick follow-up for Alvys.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alvys needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Patrick, last bit of proof for Alvys.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alvys's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B logistics-tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Patrick, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a logistics-tech motion? I will tailor it to Alvys either way.
